instructions: Preserve WIPO source applicant and patent fields exactly. Extract applicant and agent blocks independently; never assume email or phone belongs to an agent.
Use the printed Name field in each labeled contact block. Ignore signing individuals in signature sections. Never substitute an applicant name into Agent Name.
Read email and phone characters exactly. Fax and registration numbers are excluded. Missing or unclear fields are not guessed.
Quote complete visible evidence per field; keep country in the printed language. A country or address problem must not invalidate a separately verified email or phone.
Return each visibly printed email as its own field, even when several emails share one printed line. Never combine addresses into one value or repair malformed text.

Retain multiple owners and shared contact details as separate blocks. Prefer a verified applicant email when contacts differ; if the applicant has no email, use the independently verified agent email block. When contacts are shared, applicant for same address and agent for different addresses. Ambiguous owner-dependent fields require review, but a single independently verified email may be retained.
Agent Name is independently sourced from an actual agent block; Sir/Ma'am is only a display fallback for missing name, never a real identity.
Category must describe source-supported business role; do not assume every incorporated agent is Corp. Unknown classification stays blank.
Examples teach rules only; never copy example contacts into a filing.
